{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for PAID SEARCH channel and NEW customers
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Calculate the fraction of converted customers
num_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
total_new_paid_search = len(filtered_df)
fraction_converted = num_converted / total_new_paid_search

# Output the result
(fraction_converted, num_converted, total_new_paid_search)"}
